working_definition: Tbh-negative subset of the parent Tdc2(+) cluster (Davie et al. 2018, res-2.0 cluster 64; 122 cells): tyramine-releasing neurons that retain tyramine as end-product neurotransmitter (lacking Tbh, which would convert it to octopamine). Overlaps substantially in distribution with the octopaminergic sister subcluster (shared Tdc2+ lineage); not resolved to any anatomical subtype by the atlas.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any tyraminergic neuron of the adult.

justification: This is a class-level, neurotransmitter-defined cluster (Tbh- subset of Tdc2+ neurons) explicitly not resolved to any anatomical subtype. FBbt:00058204 'adult tyraminergic neuron' is the class-level FBbt term at exactly this resolution, restricted to adult tissue matching the confirmed adult (0-50 day) atlas. Per dataset guidance, remainder/class-level clusters map to the class term as the correct level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that is capable of some tyramine secretion, neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Life-stage-unspecified parent; adult-specific FBbt:00058204 better matches the confirmed adult tissue (larval tyraminergic subtypes exist in FBbt but are irrelevant here).

recommendation: Accept adult tyraminergic neuron (FBbt:00058204) as the class-level mapping; no individual tyraminergic subtype should be assigned.
